Begin the story ↓

How to read this explorer

Each section is a moment you can move through time. Press play or drag the year slider to sweep 2001–2026, and use the four technology pills to focus on Solar, Wind, Battery or EV.

About the numbers

Values are foreign direct investment in US$ millions. 12% of projects (111 of 926) are announced with value undisclosed. These read as $0 here, which is a gap in disclosure rather than a project without capital behind it. 853 of 926 projects are manufacturing; the rest are R&D, design and logistics. Figures on this page count every activity and every year in the workbook. The working paper works from 888 of 926: those announced 2000 to 2025, leaving out cancelled, paused and closed ones.

01 — Investment Over Time

The Investment
Wave

Annual FDI flows broken down by operational status. Built = Operational + Ceased + Transferred.
Takeaway

Annual flows climbed from under $0.1B in the early 2000s to multi-billion-dollar peaks in the 2020s. Across the full period, battery ($228.6B) and EV ($208.6B) lead, ahead of solar ($73.8B) and wind ($67.7B).

Where the
Money Flows

Cumulative investment by destination country and by investor country, ranked and updated year by year.
Takeaway

07 — Investment Flows

Investor to
Destination

Cumulative flows from investor countries to destinations. Sankey width = investment.
Takeaway

China originates about 39% of tracked cross-border investment; with South Korea (21%) and Japan (16%), three economies account for roughly three-quarters of all flows. The largest single corridors run from South Korea and Japan into the United States.

08 — Emerging Hubs

The New
Frontiers

Countries with the sharpest acceleration in green FDI since 2018.
Takeaway

Since 2018, the United States (+45) and Indonesia (+41) have added the most projects against their own pre-2018 records, followed by Mexico (+32), Thailand (+29) and Malaysia (+25).

Green Technology FDI Explorer

A data companion to the Net Zero Industrial Policy Lab (Johns Hopkins University) brief Mapping the Global Race for Clean Energy Manufacturing. Cross-border greenfield investment in Solar, Wind, Battery and EV manufacturing, announced 1997–2026. netzeropolicylab.com

Methodology

Values are foreign direct investment in US$ millions. Built = Operational + Ceased + Transferred; Pipeline = Under construction + Announced. 12% of projects (111 of 926) are announced with value undisclosed and read as $0 here, which is a gap in disclosure rather than a project without capital behind it.

Data & sources

Project-level dataset of announced greenfield clean-tech FDI, with each field individually sourced from public disclosures: company announcements, trade and financial press. Figures are announced or reported capital investment, not audited spend.

Vintage

Announced 1997–2026 · charted from 2001
